content: Depit Wiahla Nanmwarkien Israel oh Suda
Mehn Israel koaros ahpw patohla rehn Depit nan Epron oh patohwanohng, “Kitail udukteieu oh ntateieu.

Ahnsou samwalahr ako, pil ni ahnsou me Sohl ketin wiewia at tungoal nanmwarki, komw ketin kahluwa mehn Israel kan nan mahwen, oh KAUN-O sapwellimomwi Koht ketin inoukihong komwi me komw pahn ketin kahluwa sapwellime aramas oh ketin kaunirailda.”

Eri, kaun akan en Israel ahpw patohla rehn Nanmwarki Depit nan Epron. Ih eri ketin wiahda inou sarawi ehu ong irail, irail ahpw keiehdi, ih eri wiahla nanmwarkien Israel, nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin inoukihong Samuel pwehn padahkihong aramas akan.
Nanmwarki Depit oh mehn Israel koaros ahpw ketila oh mahweniong kahnimw Serusalem. Ni ahnsowo e adaneki Sepus, oh mehn Sepus iei irail me tepin towehla sahpwo oh ahnsowo re koukousoante wasao.
Mehn Sepus patohwanohng Depit me e sohte kak pedolong nan kahnimwo; ahpw Depit ketin kalowehdi ar kehl kehlail Saion, wasao ahpw uhd adanekihla “Kahnimw en Depit.”
Depit ahpw mahsanih, “Ohl emen me pahn tepin kemehla mehn Sepus men, pahn wiahla kaun lapalap en atail karis.” Sohap me eh nohno Seruaia, me kaunda mwekid en mahweno oh ih me wiahla kaun lapalap.
Pwehki Depit eh ketila oh kousoanla nan kelen mahweno, wasao ahpw uhd adanekihla “Kahnimw en Depit.”
E ahpw ketin kauwada sapahl kahnimwo, tepida wasa me audaud en pwehl ni palimesehn dohlo, oh Sohap onehda sapahl wasa kan me luhwe nan kahnimwo.
Depit ahpw wie kekehlailla ahnsou koaros, pwehki KAUN-O Wasa Lapalap eh kin ketin ieiang.
Sapwellimen Depit Sounpei Ndand kan

Iet mwaren sapwellimen Depit sounpei ndand kan. Iangahki aramas teikan en Israel, irail sewesehda pwe en wiahla nanmwarki, duwen me KAUN-O ketin inoukidahr, oh re kolokolete sapwellime wehi en kehlail.
Me keieu iei Sasopeam kisehn peneineien Akmon, ih me kaunen “Me Silimeno.” E peiki nah ketieuwo pelianki ohl silipwiki oh kemeirailla koaros nan mahweno.
Me keriaun ndand rehn “Me Silimeno” iei Eleasar nein Dodo, kisehn peneineien Aho.
E iang en Depit pali oh mahweniong mehn Pilisdia nan mahwen en Pas Dammim. E mihmi nan mwetin parli ehu ni ahnsou me mehn Israel tepida tangdoaui,
ih oh nah ohl ako ahpw tengediong nan werengen mwahto oh peiong mehn Pilisdia ko. KAUN-O eri ketikihong en poweiraildi.

Rahn ehu sounpei silimen sang rehn kaunen sounpei siliakano ahpw kohla ni takai ehu wasa me Depit ketiket ie limwahn pwoaren paip en Adullam, nindokon pwihn en Pilisdia ehu ar mihmi nan arail impwal kan nan Wahun Repaim.
Ni ahnsowo Depit ketiket ni dohl ehu me mie kelen mahwen ie, oh pwihn en Pilisdia ehu kakaun Pedleem.
Depit eri kupwur loaleidida oh mahsanih, “Iamen emen en wadohng ie pihl sang ni pwarer me mi ni ewen kelen Pedleem pwe I en nim!”
Sounpei ndand silimeno ahpw kotehla kahnimpwal en mehn Pilisdia ko, idip pihl sang ni pwarero, oh patohwandohng Depit. Ahpw Depit sohte men konote; e ahpw ketin wudekihla pwehn meirongkihong KAUN-O,
e ahpw mahsanih, “I sohte kak nim pihlet! Pwe e pahn rasehng me I nimala ntahn ohl pwukat me pangalahr ar mour!” Ih eri sohte konote pihlo. Ih met kan wiewia kommwad en sounpei ndand silimeno.
Apisai, rien Sohap pwutak, iei ih me kaunen “Me Ndand Silimeno.” E peiki nah ketieuwo pelianki ohl silipwiki oh kemeirailla koaros, e ahpw ndandla nanpwungen “Me Siliakano.”
Ih me keieu ndand nanpwungen “Me Siliakano” oh wiahla arail kaun, ahpw e sohte ndand duwehte “Me Silimeno.”

Penaia nein Sehoiada sang Kapseel iei ih emen sounpei ndand; e wiadahr soangen wiewia kommwad tohto, e pil kemehla sounpei kommwad riemen en Mohap. Pak ehu e kohdihla nan pwoahr ehu ni ahnsoun sinoh, oh kemehla laion men.

E pil kemehla mehn Isip men, ohl lapala oh reireiki piht isuh elep, me weuwa lapalahn ketieu pwoat. Penaia peikihong ohlo kulop ehu, e kihsang ketieuwo nan pehn ohl en Isipo, oh kemehkihla ohlo ketieuwo.
Ih met kan wiewia kommwad akan en Penaia, me iei emen kisehn “Me Siliakano.”
E inenen koahiek nanpwungen “Me Siliakano,” ahpw e sohte ndand duwehte “Me Silimeno.” Depit ketikihong en kin apwahpwalih sapwellime sounsilasil kan.
